automatable_note: These ESCs are not throttle-only: the programming steps include pressing the ESC's own button after the 2 s wait. The bench has no actuator for it.

manual.action: Press the button under the shrink tube after 2 s or the tone sequence.

entry.confirm_signal: Tone sequence after the 2 s wait; sequence after the button press.
steps: Connect the motor if tones are to be audible. Transmitter on. Throttle to motor-off.
Wait 2 s or until the ESC sounds its tone sequence.
Operator: press the ESC button (push button under the heat shrink).
The ESC sounds a tone sequence, then the mode series, mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, with a pause between series.
Move the throttle to full (stick forward) when the wanted mode sounds. Mode 3: then move the throttle to full reverse (stick back).
The ESC repeats the mode as tones. Wait for it, then disconnect power (an interrupted run locks the ESC; 8 LED flashes).

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds.

scheme.description: Throttle at motor-off, apply power, wait 2 s, press the ESC button. The ESC counts modes as tones. Full throttle selects the mode; mode 3 additionally needs a full reverse position.

values.name: DJI GPS system: stick range fixed to 1000 to 2000 microseconds; programming it resets to delivery state

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Exact timing of the 'wait 2 s or until the tone sequence' step is not stated beyond the 2 s minimum; the end of the wait is the ESC's tone sequence.
Voltage range, cell count and rated current of the models are not listed in the text read.
What differentiates mode 1 from mode 2 beyond the fixed stick range is not stated.
Button location beyond 'under the heat shrink' is not stated.
notes: INDEX.csv summarises these as throttle only; the procedure text includes a button press (step 5), so the entry needs a person.
Kontronik_Kontrol-X_Kolibri-X.pdf gives the KOLIBRI-X example as 90 LV = 90 A on the German side and 60 LV = 60 A on the English side.

Mode 3 (forward and reverse) puts full reverse at the back (Kontronik_Kontrol-X_Kolibri-X.pdf p.4, p.12), so its motor-off start is taken as the middle: entry_throttle mid. The manual does not say 'middle'. Modes 1, 2 and 4 say 'motor off' only and are taken as the back.
